data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Why is it called “beauty sleep” even though you wake up looking like a hot mess? ASSISTANT:

It is called "beauty sleep" because even though you may look like a hot mess after waking up, the effects of a good night's sleep are still visible on your skin. A good night's sleep helps to improve circulation, reduces inflammation, and stimulates the production of natural oils in the skin, resulting in a healthy glow and a refreshed look.
BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Are there minimum standards that Airbnbs are required to maintain? ASSISTANT:

Yes, Airbnbs must meet minimum standards as set by local governments.
